sourceInventoryLimitation: The pinned hdr_parser skips template declarations and does not expand declaration macros. Its declaration/callable counts cover only the non-template parser subset under the recorded source configuration. The companion source inventory records template definitions (including nested template-template parameters), function-like macro definitions/invocations and every conditional directive across all installed headers. These source units overlap and are not concrete callable counts; class-template members, macro expansions, external using declarations and concrete template instantiations are not semantically enumerated. No CUDA compilation, linking, device/runtime validation or complete callable parity is claimed.
